result.markdown:
For most small customer support teams, I'd recommend **Freshdesk as the best all-round help desk**, with **Help Scout as the best choice for a team that primarily handles email**\.

The important distinction is whether you need a straightforward shared inbox or a more structured ticketing system with automation, reporting and service-level agreements (SLAs).

Here are the five platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best help desk software compared

| Software | Best for | Indicative starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Freshdesk | Best overall | \$19/agent/month |
| Help Scout | Simple, email-first support | \$25/user/month |
| Zoho Desk | Best budget option | \$7/user/month |
| Zendesk | More complex, growing teams | \$19/agent/month for email ticketing |
| Intercom | Live chat and AI-first support | \$29/seat/month |


Indicative advertised US prices, generally based on annual billing. Plans and features differ; AI usage and add-ons can cost extra. 4. **Knowledge base\:** Customers can find answers themselves.
5. **Reporting\:** First response time, resolution time, ticket backlog and customer satisfaction.
6. **Integrations\:** Connect to your CRM, email, website and other business tools.
